notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-wi-aniwa, which has the same name and county. The FFLA Wisconsin list and OpenStreetMap place the Aniwa tower at 45.03104, -89.26429; this record's point (45.0489, -89.2342, from central_us_lookouts) is at different coordinates, a few kilometres away. Whether these are one tower is a merge decision for a human. The agency '30N' is a survey code (see corrections). The UW-Madison lead noted on us-wi-aniwa (Town of Harrison material, record AEIACW55H2OKKT8Q, possibly a farm site erected about 1934 and moved around 1939-40) is unverified: the cached UW-Madison pages hold only catalogue text for a 1988 Town of Harrison centennial history with no Aniwa text, so no build or relocation event is recorded here. The 2015 and 2019 Wisconsin figures are statewide context and do not show that Aniwa was a DNR tower. Build date, owner, staffing and removal date are unknown.
